title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-tkjl: Ack/MSG header bit layout incompatible with test vectors
description:
## Bug: Ack and MSG control header bit layout doesn't match test vectors

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:255,274,284`

**Severity:** P1 — interop failure

The shared test vectors use:
- **Bit 7**: window bit for both Ack and Fragment headers
- **Bit 6**: complete bit for Ack, part of FCN for Fragment

Our Ack `write_to` (line 255):
```rust
out[1] = ((self.window & 1) << FRAGMENT_N) | (if self.complete { 1 } else { 0 });
// Window at bit 6, complete at bit 0
```

Test vectors show:
- `ack_success: 7840` → `0x40` has bit 6 set (window=0, complete=1). Window should be at bit 7 → 0x80, complete at bit 6 → 0x40. So `0x40` = complete=1 ✓, window at bit 6... ambiguous.
- `ack_failure: 7820...` → `0x20` has bit 5 set. Our expected would be `0x00` for window=0, complete=0, bitmap=0.

The Ack/control message encoding in the test vectors also differs from our code.
